HEAD:docs/getting-started/installation.md:366:`make uninstall-legacy` (run from a repository checkout) runs `scripts/uninstall_legacy.sh`. It removes only the old Claude Code plugin install: `~/.claude/plugins/superclaude@superclaude`, `~/.claude/superclaude.json`, `~/.claude/superclaude_config.json`, and the `superclaude@superclaude` entry in `enabledPlugins` in `~/.claude/settings.json`. It backs these up to `~/.claude-superclaude-backup-<timestamp>` first. It does not remove anything `superclaude install` put in `~/.claude/`.
